title: Salt: Are you getting Enough?   (More Sodium & Health)
summary: Joseph Everett argues, drawing on the book The Salt Fix, that most people benefit from more rather than less salt, and reviews studies on sodium, potassium and blood pressure.
why: HN commenters use it as a source of study references suggesting standard low-salt advice may be too restrictive.

quote.text: This is a nice video discussing some studies that show that high levels of salt is significantly better if it comes with high levels of potassium
